# Assessment Facts Overview

Supplementary documents generated for the ServiceFabric deployment workspace. Documents are listed only when present in this report directory.

- [api-service-contracts](api-service-contracts.md) — API endpoint discovery result; container implementation sources are not included.
- [architecture-diagram](architecture-diagram.md) — Overview of the Service Fabric deployment topology, containers, and service relationships.
- [business-workflows](business-workflows.md) — Business workflow discovery result; implementation sources are not included.
- [configuration-inventory](configuration-inventory.md) — Service Fabric profiles, settings, deployment parameters, and masked sensitive configuration.
- [data-architecture](data-architecture.md) — Data-layer discovery result; SQL container is defined, but entity and access code is absent.
- [dependency-map](dependency-map.md) — Declared build package and runtime container dependencies.
